[discrete#release-9-0-6.changelog-release]
=== ProjectForge 9.0.6 released

[.changelog-source]
__2026-10-14, tag https://github.com/micromata/projectforge/tree/9.0.6-RELEASE[9.0.6-RELEASE]__ +++{% include release-pills.html tag="9.0.6-RELEASE" docker="9.0.6" mini=true %}+++

- **Leave applications** and **leave account** in the new interface
- **Lanes & Planes** interface for employees and cost centers
- Data transfer files encrypted at rest
- Password change: brute force protection, other sessions ended
- Fix: contribution margin counts by booking period

.Overview
[%collapsible]
====
- **Leave applications:** list and form migrated to the new interface, with bars over the calendar days showing the days without any substitute, a year filter paging back and forth and the days left updated while editing.
- **Leave account:** migrated to the new interface, with the next year in the statistics and leave applications without any substitute marked red.
- **Lanes & Planes:** the active employees are pushed with their cost centers, cost units and creditor account, safeguarded against suspiciously small user lists and email changes; employees have a new field creditor account.
- **Users:** new fields alternative and former e-mail addresses, searchable and in the Excel export.
- **Data transfer:** files in the file system are compressed and can be encrypted at rest (AES-256).
- **Passwords:** change password and change WLAN password in the new interface; a wrong old password counts as failed login attempt, and a password change ends the user's other sessions.
- **System administration:** system statistics load at once, copy & paste samples for the alert message; the Docker image is based on Java 21.
- **Fixes:** contribution margin by booking period, year filter of leave applications and contracts, lists returning with an outdated filter, sorting of the vacation list, rejected leave applications in the vacation export, cost unit cache refresh in the time sheet form, phone lookup key and CSRF check of force delete.
====

.All changes
[%collapsible]
====

++++
{% include tag.html tag="added" %}
++++
- Employees: new field creditor account (the DATEV account of the employee, e.g. for travel expenses), also shown as a column in the list and in the Excel export.
- **Lanes & Planes interface**
  * The active employees are pushed with the general Kost1 as cost centers, the general Kost2 and the Kost2 they may book on (restricted by patterns like 5.__.02) as cost units, their Kost1 as reference cost center, their creditor account and their nickname as abbreviation. Numbers are sent without dots (as the DATEV export of Lanes & Planes requires). Finance maintains these settings in the configuration parameter "Lanes & Planes"; activation and API key are set in projectforge.lanesandplanes.__.
  * Additional users who aren't employees (e.g. an external accountant) can be entered in the configuration parameter. They are sent with name and email only, so they aren't deactivated and their role and managers are kept. The service admin and guest profiles of Lanes & Planes can't be entered: the import doesn't touch them.
  * Cost centers and cost units already existing in Lanes & Planes can be entered with their names in the configuration parameter (pasted from the user export). They are sent under that name, so Lanes & Planes reuses them instead of rejecting them as duplicates.
  * A changed email of an employee is held back (the old one is still sent, with a hint on the problem dashboard) until it was changed in Lanes & Planes and confirmed in the configuration parameter. Otherwise Lanes & Planes would deactivate the user and create a new one.
  * A suspiciously small user list isn't pushed (Lanes & Planes deactivates every user not sent): it's checked against a minimum number of users and against the last push, also after a restart of ProjectForge. A missing push state is reported on the problem dashboard.
- Data transfer: files stored in the file system are compressed and can be encrypted at rest (AES-256, key in projectforge.files.fileSystemEncryptionKey), so backups of the file system don't contain them in plain text.
- Users: new fields alternative and former e-mail addresses (comma separated, e.g. after a change of name), also searchable and in the Excel export.

++++
{% include tag.html tag="improved" %}
++++
- System administration: two copy & paste samples for the alert message (maintenance, new release), with the next full hour and the next release filled in.
- Change password and change WLAN password are pages of the new user interface and show when the password was last changed.
- **System statistics**
  * The database tile appears at once: the number of history entries and attributes is the estimate of the database (~) instead of a count taking minutes.
  * Tiles still loading show their title and a spinner.
  * CPU load and system load average as bars.
- **Leave account**
  * Moved to the new interface; the statistics now include the next year as well.
  * Leave applications with a day without any substitute are marked red.
  * A leave application or leave account entry opened from the leave account returns to it.
- **Leave applications**
  * List and form moved to the new interface; working days, days left and the vacations of the substitutes follow the form as it is edited.
  * The form charts the vacation and the overlapping vacations of the substitutes over the calendar days, with weekends, holidays and the days without any substitute.
  * The list shows each leave application as a bar over its days, with the days without any substitute in red.
  * Only the statuses that may be set are offered.
  * A leave application opened from the calendar returns to it on save.
- **Leave applications**
  * The period and the employee are always on the filter row of the list; the period finds every leave application overlapping it.
  * The period is a calendar year by default, the list starts with the current one: any date entered gives its year, and the arrows page a year back or forth. A month or a free range can be chosen instead.
  * The form shows the vacation days left once the application being edited is counted, too, in red where they are not enough.

++++
{% include tag.html tag="changed" %}
++++
- Docker image: based on Java 21 (Eclipse Temurin 21 JRE) instead of Java 17. ProjectForge still runs on Java 17 or newer.

++++
{% include tag.html tag="fixed" %}
++++
- **Contribution margin (order book and scripts)**
  * Accounting records count in the month of their record number (booking period), not in the month of their date: an invoice of September booked into August now counts as booked in August.
  * Scripts include the current month up to today as preliminary values (time sheets and unbooked invoices).
- Time sheet form: choosing a task could fail now and then with "Session/EntityManager is closed" while the cost unit cache was being refreshed.
- **Lists**
  * A list came back from an entry with an outdated filter when it had been paged back to a filter used shortly before (e.g. a year back and forth).
- **Security**
  * Phone lookup (/rsPublic/phoneLookup) is disabled until an own key is configured in projectforge.phoneLookupKey; the former default placeholder is no longer accepted.
  * Force delete checks the CSRF token like all other write actions.
- **Vacation export**
  * Rejected leave applications are no longer exported.
- Vacation list: sorting by the status or the days column had no effect.
- **Year filter**
  * The year filter of the leave applications and the contracts is applied again; it was ignored in the new interface.

++++
{% include tag.html tag="security" %}
++++
- Changing the own password or WLAN password: a wrong old password counts as failed login attempt and locks further attempts for a while, like the login does.
- A password change (own, by an admin or by a password reset) now also ends the user's other open sessions, not only the stay-logged-in devices. The session the own password was changed in stays logged in.
====

[discrete#release-9-0-5.changelog-release]
=== ProjectForge 9.0.5 released

[.changelog-source]
__2026-10-13, tag https://github.com/micromata/projectforge/tree/9.0.5-RELEASE[9.0.5-RELEASE]__ +++{% include release-pills.html tag="9.0.5-RELEASE" docker="9.0.5" %}+++

[.changelog-checksum]
SHA-256 of projectforge-application-9.0.5.jar: `+044f60907c25c056a44baf6d457c6b951190ef7fd36f795359bbf044026086a0+`

- **Vacation** booked as time sheets automatically
- **Admin log viewer** with log file search, now in the system dashboard
- **My account** in the new interface
- Hanging cache refreshes and scheduler runs can be terminated
- Fix: current exchange rates suggested again

.Overview
[%collapsible]
====
- **Vacation:** a nightly job books past approved vacation days without time sheets, enabled on the configuration page; unbooked vacation days count again as days without time sheets in the monthly report and the notifications, listed separately and bookable with a click.
- **Configuration:** parameters grouped by category, showing who may see and change each one; the former vacation settings of projectforge.properties are taken over once.
- **Admin log viewer:** a tab of the system dashboard; search in the log files of the last days, the context of each entry inline, customizable tables.
- **System dashboard:** hanging cache refreshes and scheduler runs can be terminated, blocked database statements time out, a failed cache refresh is retried after a minute at the earliest; the last successful run of a job is shown.
- **My account:** migrated to the new interface, with the devices staying logged in, the usage of access tokens and longer GPG and SSH keys.
- **Notifications:** new rule for passwords not changed for a given number of days.
- **Changelog:** the releases of a major version newest first.
- **Fixes:** exchange rate suggestions, JCR migration in the packaged application, sorting of the Merlin template list.
====

.All changes
[%collapsible]
====

++++
{% include tag.html tag="added" %}
++++
- **Admin log viewer**
  * Live view: each entry opens its context, the events before and after it in memory, all of them or only those of the same user or logger; with a logger column.
  * Search in the log files of the last days by text, period, level and logger category (to show or to hide), also for the days before the server's start.
  * Each hit opens its context inline: the entries before and after it, all of them or only those of the same user or logger, with paging to older and newer ones. Also for the occurrences of a problem of the system dashboard.
  * The tables of the live view and of the log file search can be customized (column width, pinning, showing and hiding), stored per user as in all other lists.
- **System dashboard**
  * A hanging cache refresh or scheduler run can be terminated, so it can run again at once without a restart.
  * Cache refreshes and scheduler runs no longer wait endlessly for a database lock: a blocked statement fails after a timeout (60 seconds by default).
  * After a failed cache refresh, the cache serves its current data and retries after a minute at the earliest, instead of retrying on every access.
- Approved vacation can be booked as time sheets automatically: a nightly job books the past vacation days without any time sheet on the configured vacation task and cost unit, never in advance and never further back than its last successful run, so a deleted vacation time sheet isn't booked again. Finance and controlling enable it on the configuration page (maximum days back, vacation task and cost unit); the former settings in projectforge.properties are taken over into the configuration once (a property still set afterwards is ignored and reported as a problem on the system dashboard on every start, so it can be removed), and invalid values are refused on saving. The configuration list now groups the parameters by category and shows who may see and who may change each parameter. The statistics of the scheduled jobs also keep the last successful run; after a failed run, the system dashboard shows when the job succeeded last.
- Notifications: a new rule notifies users whose password hasn't been changed for more than a given number of days, with a link to change it. The notification is resolved once the password is changed.

++++
{% include tag.html tag="improved" %}
++++
- Changelog: the releases of a major version are listed newest first, the release opening it last, linked from the top of the major; the release notes of an update link to it as well.

++++
{% include tag.html tag="changed" %}
++++
- The admin log viewer is now a tab of the system dashboard; its own menu entry is gone, and old links lead to the tab.
- Approved vacation days without time sheets count again as days without time sheets in the monthly report and the notifications about missing time sheets. The monthly report lists working days and vacation days without time sheets separately, a click on the vacation days opens the dialog for booking several days; notification texts can list all days, only the vacation days or only the other working days without time sheets.
- **My account**
  * Migrated to the new interface; old links lead to the new page. Saving stays on the page, and a changed language, time zone or date format takes effect at once.
  * Devices staying logged in are listed with browser, IP address and last access, the current device is marked; each one can be logged out on its own.
  * The usage of an access token is shown as a table of the clients (browser, IP address, last access, number of accesses).
  * The language can be set back to the browser's default.
  * An empty date format or time notation names the default that applies; the mobile phone links to the setup of the second factor, where it is changed.

++++
{% include tag.html tag="fixed" %}
++++
- Migration of files out of the JCR failed in the packaged application with "No LoginModule found".
- Currency conversion: current exchange rates are suggested again when a new conversion rate is created or its valid-from date is changed (the exchange rate API had moved).
- Merlin templates: sorting the list by the admins, users or groups column works (the list was left unsorted).
- My account: GPG and SSH public keys may now have up to 20,000 characters (were 4,096, a longer GPG key couldn't be saved); a key that is still too long is shown as an error at the field.

++++
{% include download-link.html %}
++++

[discrete#release-9-0-4.changelog-release]
=== ProjectForge 9.0.4 released

[.changelog-source]
__2026-10-11, tag https://github.com/micromata/projectforge/tree/9.0.4-RELEASE[9.0.4-RELEASE]__ +++{% include release-pills.html tag="9.0.4-RELEASE" docker="9.0.4" %}+++

[.changelog-checksum]
SHA-256 of projectforge-application-9.0.4.jar: `+47595cb45f18b15f3830463a2177ddfc7d2ccfc3b74f4339c289e50e16cd6d78+`

- **Notifications** (experimental) in the app and by mail
- **System dashboard** with statistics, scheduler and caches
- **Scripts** in the new interface, also as buttons on selected pages
- Time sheets: no more overlaps on the same cost 2
- Fix: user-entered texts in mails no longer taken over as HTML

.Overview
[%collapsible]
====
- **Notifications (experimental):** rules notify users in the app (toast, banner, menu counter) and by mail, also as a cascade; first rules for missing time sheets and expiring vacation days, plus manual messages.
- **System dashboard:** the problem dashboard becomes the system dashboard, with the system statistics and the new tabs scheduler and caches; problems (in German now "Störungen") can be changed many at once, the tiles count only open ones.
- **Scripts:** list, form and execution pages in the new interface with a code editor and toolbar; the output gets a tab of its own; a script can appear as a button on selected pages and gets their filter.
- **Time sheets:** bookings on the same cost 2 may no longer overlap; new configuration parameter for overlap groups.
- **Rich text:** markdown is shown formatted and taken over by the editor, which now offers headings and tables; also used for the message of the day and the AI-savings note.
- **Forecast:** snapshot date for the order book as of a given day, hint for the planning date.
- **Lists and data transfer:** exports in an Export menu; data transfer with capacity bar, configurable file columns and the activity log as a tab.
- **Fixes:** HTML in user-entered mail texts, poll mails, cancelled invoices count as paid, attachment rename, liquidity entries cloneable, task tree under concurrent changes, project list sorted by number.
====

.All changes
[%collapsible]
====

++++
{% include tag.html tag="added" %}
++++
- **Statistics, forecast**
  * New field snapshot date: the forecast is calculated from the order book as it was on that day.
  * The tooltip of the planning date shows a hint maintained by finance in the new configuration parameter "Forecast" (formatted text with a small editor).
- Notifications (experimental): admins and finance can set up rules that notify users in the app (toast, toast to be confirmed or banner, with the levels info, important and urgent, optionally as a menu counter) and by mail, also as a cascade (e.g. a mail if not confirmed in the app within two days). First rules: missing time sheets and vacation days about to expire; a manual rule sends a message on demand. Recipients are groups, users and employees by status, by default only those concerned. Texts are formatted and contain variables such as the list of days without time sheets. Who confirmed a notification and when is recorded. The problem dashboard shows the state of the notification jobs. Approved vacation days no longer count as days without time sheets, also in the monthly report.
- Scripts: a script can be shown as a button with a tooltip in the top right corner of selected pages, e.g. the order book or other lists, and the forecast or contribution margin tab of the order statistics. The button opens the script's execution page, and the script gets the current filter of that page as variable pageContext (e.g. pageContext.list() for the shown entries).
- **System dashboard: new tab "Scheduler"**
  * Lists every scheduled job with area, description, schedule, last and next run, duration and status; sortable, with the columns stored per user like every list; overdue and failed jobs stand out, also as a tile in the overview.
  * The runs are stored per day (failed and slow runs one by one) and merged into months after 90 days.
  * A job can be started at once; a run is skipped while the previous one is still running.
- **System dashboard: new tab "Caches"**
  * Lists every cache with its state, last refresh, duration, expiry time and failed refreshes; a single cache or all caches can be refreshed by hand.
  * Hanging cache refreshes are detected every minute, reported as problem and interrupted; stuck and failed caches also show up as a tile in the overview.
  * The button "Refresh all caches" of the system page is replaced by the caches tab, which refreshes every cache, not only a fixed selection.

++++
{% include tag.html tag="improved" %}
++++
- Data transfer: the used capacity of an area is shown as a colored fill-level bar, in the list and in the file view.
- Mass update: the file name of the Excel protocol now contains the entity name (e.g. invoices).
- Configuration: the note on AI savings in time sheets and the message of the day on the login page are edited with the rich text editor (bold, italic, lists, links, colours).
- Problem dashboard: the key figures and the subsystem tiles now count only the problems that still need a look. Resolved, ignored and muted problems are shown separately below each figure, so handling a problem changes the tiles at once.
- Rich text: texts written in markdown (e.g. older tooltips and notes) are shown formatted instead of with their raw markup, and the editor takes them over directly; they are stored in the rich text format on the next save. Markdown pasted as plain text is converted as well. The editor now also offers headings (levels 1 to 4) and tables.
- System dashboard: the problem dashboard is now called system dashboard and also shows the system statistics in a tab of their own, which replaces their menu entry; old links are redirected. The statistics are part of the new interface and show each section as soon as its figures are collected instead of waiting for all of them. Memory, disks, the database connection pool and the database server connections are shown as fill-level bars, and new figures were added: pool configuration and maximum size, database version and size, CPU load, processors, physical memory, operating system, non-heap memory, garbage collection and thread counts.
- Code editor (scripts): a toolbar with undo, redo, search and replace and comment out, each naming its keyboard shortcut in the tooltip, and an info button listing all shortcuts. The search panel is shown at the top and in the user's language.
- Dark mode: the text is rendered in a lighter weight and smoothed, so it no longer looks overly bold on the dark background.
- Data transfer: the columns of an area's file table can be shown, hidden, reordered, pinned and resized like in every list; the layout and the sort order are kept per user for all areas.
- Lists: the exports (Excel, PDF, forecast, cost assignments, ics) are now in an "Export" menu right beside the gear menu, each entry with its explanation shown directly in the menu.
- System dashboard: with the multi selection, many problems can be picked at once and acknowledged, resolved, ignored, reopened, muted or unmuted together. In German the problems are now called "Störungen".

++++
{% include tag.html tag="changed" %}
++++
- Data transfer: the activity log of an area is a tab of its own (after Info) instead of a dialog.
- Scripts: the script list, the script form, "My scripts" and the execution pages are part of the new interface, with a code editor with syntax highlighting. The descriptions of a script and of its parameters are rich text (existing Markdown is converted on the next save). A stored script now always runs as stored; only the parameter values are taken from the form. Code executed directly (without a stored script) now runs as Kotlin instead of Groovy.
- Scripts: the output of an execution (result, log) is shown in its own tab, which opens after the run. A file to download is shown prominently at the top of both the output and the execution tab.
- Groovy scripts: only the Groovy core and its date, JSON, XML and template modules are bundled; the other modules (e.g. Ant, SQL, Swing, console) were removed.

++++
{% include tag.html tag="fixed" %}
++++
- Attachments: a changed file name or description was not saved.
- Project list: sorting by the number column had no effect.
- Personal box and employee fields: the "select me" button for picking oneself was missing.
- Time sheet list: the hint that the filter needs a date or structure element is now shown highlighted above the list instead of easily overlooked below it.
- Outgoing invoices: cancelled invoices and their cancellations now count as paid. They no longer appear under the filter 'unpaid' and are no longer included in the sums above the list (gross, net, open).
- Problem dashboard: a mail that couldn't be sent is now reported once as a mail problem, no longer a second time as an unexpected error of the function that sent it.
- Task list and task tree: no more sporadic internal errors while another user creates or moves a task at the same time.
- Attachments: long file names without spaces are wrapped in the attachment table instead of widening it.
- Liquidity planning: entries can be cloned again; a clone of a recurring entry is a standalone entry.
- Mails: names, titles, file names and texts entered by users are no longer taken over as HTML (e.g. in the mails of polls, data transfer areas, vacations and to-dos); only simple formatting and links remain in the mail text of a poll.
- **Polls**
  * The links in the mails point to this installation instead of a fixed server; the link of the invitation works again.
  * The reminder before the deadline goes only to the participants who haven't responded yet.
  * The subject of the invitation no longer shows HTML tags; subject and text of the mail after the deadline are no longer swapped.
- **Time sheets: no more overlapping bookings on the same cost unit**
  * Two time sheets of a user on the same cost 2 (or, without cost 2, on the same structure element) may no longer overlap in time, even if a shared cost element is involved. Before, e.g. a vacation could be booked twice for the same time if the cost 2 had no project.
  * New configuration parameter "Time sheet overlap groups": groups of cost 2 number prefixes (e.g. "6" for all cost 2 units 6.*) whose time sheets never overlap; for shared costs, a group counts like one project. Visible to finance and controlling, changed only by members of both groups.
  * Existing overlapping bookings are shown by the filter "Only collisions" of the time sheet list.

++++
{% include tag.html tag="security" %}
++++
- npm vulnerabilities in projectforge-next and projectforge-webapp fixed: @modelcontextprotocol/sdk, proxy-addr, sharp and source-map-js updated.

++++
{% include download-link.html %}
++++

[discrete#release-9-0-3.changelog-release]
=== ProjectForge 9.0.3 released

[.changelog-source]
__2026-10-08, tag https://github.com/micromata/projectforge/tree/9.0.3-RELEASE[9.0.3-RELEASE]__ +++{% include release-pills.html tag="9.0.3-RELEASE" docker="9.0.3" %}+++

[.changelog-checksum]
SHA-256 of projectforge-application-9.0.3.jar: `+fbe9999a9a8b919e8c421c6d275da44a408a26c2ed609e5564ea099efc18a2a0+`

- **New file store** in the database replacing the JCR
- Calendar: book several days also on already booked days
- Fixes from the **problem dashboard**
- Fix: user settings saved again on logout

.Overview
[%collapsible]
====
- **File store:** with `+projectforge.files.store=db+` all files are stored in the database, data transfer files in the file system; existing installations stay on the JCR until switched.
- **JCR migration:** after switching, files are copied in the background and verified by size and checksum, with a report; switching back or a rollback stays possible. The system page shows the active store and starts backup ZIP and migration.
- **Backups:** the admin guide describes a main dump and a separate dump of the files; the backup purge handles several prefixes.
- **Calendar:** booking several days also books days that already have time sheets, as long as nothing collides; the preview shows each overlap.
- **Data transfer:** areas sorted by last modification, latest first.
- **Problem dashboard fixes:** structure tree and list filters without a session, field error for a time sheet without a task, invoices found by order number, fewer needless error log entries.
- **Projects:** changing cost 2 types of an ended project in the mass update is reported as an error, with the reason in the Excel export.
- **Fixes:** user settings saved again on logout, Safari browser back, tall company logos on legacy pages, wider mail layout, e-invoice checker error message, rare internal error when opening an order.
====

.All changes
[%collapsible]
====

++++
{% include tag.html tag="added" %}
++++
- **File store**
  * New file store replacing the JCR (Apache Oak): with `+projectforge.files.store=db+` all files are stored in the database (schema `+pf_files+`), data transfer files in the file system (directory `+datatransfer+` of the home directory). Existing installations stay on the JCR until switched to `+db+` (see the admin guide).
  * After switching to `+db+`, all files of the JCR are copied in the background and verified by size and checksum, with a report in `+jcr-migration-report.txt+` in the home directory; the JCR keeps them, so switching back or a rollback to the former release is possible. The migration continues on the next start if it was interrupted.
  * System page: the card "Document repository (JCR)" shows the active store and starts the JCR backup ZIP and the migration.
  * Backups: the admin guide describes two dumps, the main dump without the schema `+pf_files+` and a separate dump of the files; the backup purge accepts several comma-separated prefixes and purges each backup series on its own.

++++
{% include tag.html tag="improved" %}
++++
- Calendar, book several days: a day already booked is booked as well if the new time sheet doesn't collide with an existing one (an overlap allowed by a shared cost element is fine); the preview shows each overlap and whether it is allowed.
- Data transfer: the list of areas is sorted by the last modification, latest first, by default.

++++
{% include tag.html tag="fixed" %}
++++
- **Problems from the problem dashboard**
  * Structure tree and list filters no longer fail without a session.
  * A time sheet without a task shows a field error instead of a server error.
  * The vacation list is sortable by the mode column.
  * Invoices are found by the number of their order.
  * No more needless error log entries for unsaved orders, invalid search syntax (now a warning) and a systemic failure of calendar subscriptions (logged at most once a day).
- Legacy pages: a tall company logo is limited in height and no longer covers parts of the application.
- Mails: wider layout; field names in the change history no longer wrap letter by letter.
- Projects: changing the cost 2 types of an already ended project in the mass update is an error instead of being silently skipped; the Excel export of the mass update shows the changed cost 2 types and lists failed entries with their reason. The edit form of an ended project shows its existing cost 2 units checked and ended.
- Safari: browser back from an entry returns to the list again instead of skipping it and landing on an earlier page.
- Changed user settings (e.g. list filters and column layouts) are saved again on logout instead of being lost.
- E-invoice checker: an e-invoice whose amount due doesn't match its lines is shown with this error instead of "no e-invoice data found".
- Orders: opening an order could rarely fail with an internal error.

++++
{% include download-link.html %}
++++
====

[discrete#release-9-0-2.changelog-release]
=== ProjectForge 9.0.2 released

[.changelog-source]
__2026-10-06, tag https://github.com/micromata/projectforge/tree/9.0.2-RELEASE[9.0.2-RELEASE]__ +++{% include release-pills.html tag="9.0.2-RELEASE" docker="9.0.2" %}+++

- Calendar: **book several days** at once
- Orders: **further contact persons** instead of fixed roles
- Chart pages with **rearrangeable tiles**
- Faster forecast and contribution margin
- Project list: last activity columns

.Overview
[%collapsible]
====
- **Calendar:** book several days at once, e.g. a vacation or an absence for a colleague; weekends, holidays and booked days are skipped, half working days booked pro rata.
- **Orders:** one contact person plus any number of further contact persons instead of project manager, head of business and key account manager; they get the same access and the change mail.
- **Charts:** chart pages show charts as tiles that can be reordered, resized and hidden, stored per user.
- **Statistics:** forecast and contribution margin calculated much faster; forecast analysis of an order opens in a dialog from the forecast tables.
- **Project list:** sortable columns for the last time sheet, last order date and last activity to spot ended projects.
- **Problem dashboard:** a click on a key figure shows the problems it counts; the mail tile shows the outcome of the last mail; failing calendar subscriptions are reported in the error digest.
- **Lists:** the search box gets the focus on page load; statistics and problem dashboard moved to new URLs with redirects.
- **Fixes:** a cloned time sheet keeps its user, search terms highlighted in cells with JIRA links, no stale frontend files in the release jar.
====

.All changes
[%collapsible]
====

++++
{% include tag.html tag="added" %}
++++
- Project list: columns for the last time sheet, the last order date and the last activity (the later of both), sortable, to spot projects that have probably ended.
- Problem dashboard: a click on a key figure (new problems, regressions, external systems etc.) shows exactly the problems it counts.
- Chart pages (statistics, liquidity forecast, invoices, my statistics): charts as tiles that can be reordered by drag and drop, resized in steps and hidden; the arrangement is stored per user.
- Calendar: book several days at once, e.g. a vacation or an absence booked on behalf of a colleague; weekends, holidays and already booked days are skipped, half working days are booked pro rata, templates, recent time sheets and the booked user's vacations can be taken over (vacation task and cost unit configurable via projectforge.timesheet.vacation.taskId/kost2).
- Statistics: a pill behind the order number in the forecast tables opens the forecast analysis of the order in a dialog, without leaving the table.
- Lists: the search box gets the focus on page load (not on touch devices).

++++
{% include tag.html tag="improved" %}
++++
- Orders: one contact person plus any number of further contact persons instead of project manager, head of business and key account manager (existing entries are migrated, the old fields remain in the database). Further contact persons have the same access to the order and its invoices as the contact person, and the change mail now also goes to them and to everyone who has edited the order before.
- Statistics: forecast and contribution margin are calculated much faster; the contribution margin is cached per project.
- Contribution margin configuration: a cost unit assigned twice is marked as an error.
- Cost units: the cost type is shown only for customer cost units (4.x and 5.x) in the list and export, as in the monthly report.
- Problem dashboard: the mail tile shows the outcome of the last mail sent (unknown, OK, send failed or mail server unreachable).
- Failing calendar subscriptions no longer send a separate mail to the administrator and the feedback address; the error digest reports them.
- The statistics page moves to /next/finance/statistics and the problem dashboard to /next/problemDashboard; old links are redirected.

++++
{% include tag.html tag="fixed" %}
++++
- A cloned time sheet (e.g. dragged in the calendar) keeps its user if the logged-in user may book for them.
- Search terms are highlighted in list cells with JIRA links, too (order title and reference, task, time sheet, HR planning).
- The release jar no longer carries stale frontend files of earlier builds.

[discrete#release-9-0-0.changelog-release]
=== ProjectForge 9.0: a new frontend, Wicket retired, all libraries up to date

[.changelog-source]
__2026-10-06, tag https://github.com/micromata/projectforge/tree/9.0.0-RELEASE[9.0.0-RELEASE]__ +++{% include release-pills.html tag="9.0.0-RELEASE" docker="9.0.0" %}+++

[.changelog-checksum]
SHA-256 of projectforge-application-9.0.0.jar: `+1289b10a87ef77d5f25ea6e363d809fe894d661a60b8ccca7733450362dce5cb+`

- **New frontend projectforge-next:** all pages migrated, Wicket removed
- **Problem dashboard** and error digest mails for operations
- **Charts and key figures:** order statistics, contribution margins, forecast
- **E-invoicing** (XRechnung, ZUGFeRD) and **identity provider** integration
- **Robust interfaces** to external systems
- Up-to-date stack: Spring Boot 4.1, Hibernate 7.4, Next.js 16

.Overview
[%collapsible]
====
- **New frontend projectforge-next:** all pages migrated, including calendar, time sheets, order book, invoices, structure tree, access rights, monthly report, liquidity planning and administration. The classic Wicket module has been removed.
- **Problem dashboard:** log events are classified and aggregated into problems with a persistent status, with links into the log viewer, a JSON export for an AI-assisted analysis and prioritized error digest mails instead of one mail per error.
- **Charts and key figures:** order statistics with budget scenario, contribution margins, forecast, invoicing and net sum charts with a year-earlier comparison, invoicing quota and error figures in the system statistics.
- **Robust interfaces:** timeouts, connection pools, bounded sync threads and sync statistics for LDAP, identity provider, iCal, SMS, Sipgate and the gateway; an unreachable system fails fast instead of blocking, failing calendar subscriptions are retried with a growing interval.
- **E-invoicing:** XRechnung and ZUGFeRD export of outgoing invoices, PEPPOL validation, cancellation invoices and an e-invoice checker.
- **Identity provider:** synchronization of users, groups and passwords with Authentik or Keycloak (module projectforge-idp).
- **Finance:** recurring liquidity entries, DATEV import of incoming invoices, salary import, currency conversion with online exchange rates.
- **Technology:** Spring Boot 4.1, Spring 7, Hibernate 7.4, Hibernate Search 8.4, Tomcat 11, Kotlin 2.3, Next.js 16, React 19, TanStack Table.
====

.All changes
[%collapsible]
====
ProjectForge 9.0 is a major update. The classic Wicket user interface was replaced by **projectforge-next**, a new frontend built with Next.js and React, and all libraries were brought up to date. It also brings a problem dashboard for operations, many new charts with key figures, robust interfaces to external systems, e-invoicing and an identity provider integration. The development builds leading up to it are listed in the changelog as 8.2 snapshots.

[red]##**Major update**## - The classic Wicket user interface is gone: all pages run in **projectforge-next**, the only login is `+/next/login+`. This release sums up all 8.2 snapshot builds.

**Before updating** - Back up the database; its schema is migrated automatically at the first start.

++++
{% include tag.html tag="added" %}
++++
- **projectforge-next**
  * New frontend built with Next.js and React, with light and dark theme, compact top navigation and a quick access search for the menu.
  * Tables with column filters, pinning, reordering, saved layouts and filter favorites; multi selection and mass update for many entities.
  * Login with two-factor authentication and password reset under `+/next/login+`; __stay logged in__ with one token per device.
- **E-invoicing**
  * XRechnung export and ZUGFeRD PDF with embedded XML, PEPPOL validation, invoice attachments embedded in the export.
  * Cancellation invoices and an e-invoice checker for ZUGFeRD/XRechnung files.
- Identity provider integration (module projectforge-idp): users, groups and passwords synchronized with Authentik or Keycloak, including WLAN password hashes.
- **Problem dashboard**
  * Log events are classified at the call site and aggregated in the database into problems with a persistent status.
  * Dashboard with tiles per subsystem, links into the log viewer, search of a problem's occurrences in the log files and an export as JSON for an AI-assisted analysis.
  * Prioritized error digest mails per audience instead of one mail per error; early digest for new security and data problems.
- **Charts and key figures**
  * Order statistics with its own filter, charts, data tables, budget scenario and warnings about lost budgets.
  * Contribution margins in the order book, forecast charts, net sum charts of outgoing invoices and invoice statistics with a year-earlier comparison.
  * Invoicing quota as a chart and in __My statistics__; error figures in the system statistics.
- Recurring series in the liquidity planning.
- Address import and export as vCard and from free text, with a diff view and a warning about duplicates.
- Incoming invoices imported from DATEV, with currency and exchange rates looked up online.
- Gateway for external data transfer with delta sync, CardDAV favorites and a public heartbeat.
- ICS import of team events with a diff preview.
- Changelog with news, search and highlighting under `+/next/changelog+`, also in German.

++++
{% include tag.html tag="improved" %}
++++
- All pages migrated to projectforge-next, among them calendar, time sheets, order book, outgoing and incoming invoices, structure tree, access rights, monthly report, liquidity planning, DATEV and salary import, HR planning, Gantt charts and administration; links and bookmarks of the classic pages lead to the new ones.
- Configurable customer groups and business units as filters for time sheets, invoices, projects and orders.
- Structure element picker with recently used entries and favorites; JIRA issue links in lists and forms.
- Server-side paging of order and invoice lists; deleted entries can be restored.
- **Robust interfaces**
  * Timeouts and shared connection pools for LDAP, identity provider, iCal, SMS, Sipgate and the gateway, configurable per interface.
  * An unreachable or too slow system fails fast with one warning instead of blocking; sync runs use bounded threads instead of a new thread per trigger.
  * Failing calendar subscriptions are retried with a growing interval and deactivated after 90 days.
  * Sync statistics with timing and counts per run, shown in the system statistics.

++++
{% include tag.html tag="fixed" %}
++++
- Order book and invoices no longer freeze when two caches refresh at once.
- Many N+1 query floods removed; large ID lists stay under the database's bind parameter limit.
- Subscribed calendars, the MS Project export of Gantt charts, the Word-to-PDF conversion and the LDAP sync repaired.

++++
{% include tag.html tag="security" %}
++++
- CSRF protection and complete field validation for the REST calls; access checks for all REST endpoints, enforced by an architecture test.
- Security review of the filter chain: trusted proxies, client IP detection, throttling, safe redirect URLs.
- 2FA required for sensitive pages; deleted groups never grant access rights.

++++
{% include tag.html tag="removed" %}
++++
- Module projectforge-wicket with all classic pages, Wicket-only i18n keys and libraries no longer used.
- AG Grid (replaced by TanStack Table), react-scripts (replaced by Vite) and JAXB.

++++
{% include tag.html tag="admin" %}
++++
- Legacy XML user preferences are migrated to the JSON store.

++++
{% include tag.html tag="technology" %}
++++
- Spring Boot 4.1, Spring 7, Hibernate 7.4, Hibernate Search 8.4, Tomcat 11.
- Kotlin 2.3, JUnit 6, Gradle 9.8, Next.js 16, React 19, TanStack Table, Vite and Vitest.
- Versions are numbered X.Y.Z and built by a release script, the version is set in one place.

++++
{% include download-link.html %}
++++
====

[.changelog-source]
__2026-09-01, snapshot build https://github.com/micromata/projectforge/commit/0633fde56[develop@0633fde56], https://github.com/micromata/projectforge/compare/e8819bffc..0633fde56[changes since e8819bffc]__ +++{% include release-pills.html %}+++

- Invoices, structure tree, calendar and time sheets migrated
- Multi selection, mass update and period filters in lists
- **Light/dark theme** and JIRA issue links
- Fix: order book and invoices no longer freeze

.Overview
[%collapsible]
====
- **Migrated to projectforge-next:** outgoing and creditor invoices, structure tree and wizard, groups, calendar with team events, time sheet list and form.
- **Lists and forms:** multi selection with mass update for invoices, period filters with paging arrows, server-side paging of order and invoice lists, restore of deleted entries.
- **Usability:** light/dark theme toggle, JIRA issue links in lists and forms, recently used menu entries and quick access search for the menu.
- **Time sheets:** overlapping time sheets allowed for shared cost elements.
- **Invoices:** invoice statistics with a year-earlier comparison.
- **Fixes:** order book and invoices no longer freeze on concurrent cache refreshes, many N+1 query floods removed, large ID lists batched, project managers can save orders again, invoiced amounts survive a restart.
- **Security and Docker:** safe redirect URLs, 2FA again when saving orders and cost centres; Docker container buildable and startable again.
====

.All changes
[%collapsible]
====

++++
{% include tag.html tag="improved" %}
++++
- **Migrated to projectforge-next**
  * Outgoing invoices with clone, Word and e-invoice export, cost assignments and attachments; creditor invoices with CSV import.
  * Structure tree (tree and list perspective, keyboard navigation), structure element edit page and structure wizard.
  * Groups, including member mail addresses and LDAP information.
  * Calendar with toolbar, favorites, settings, drag and drop, jump to date; team events with reminders, recurrence and series modification.
  * Time sheet list and edit form with recent entries, templates, location suggestions, consumption bar and PDF/Excel export.
- **Lists and forms**
  * Multi selection with an explicit selection mode, mass update for invoices.
  * Period filters (month, term, year to date) with paging arrows; date pickers reaching beyond the current year.
  * Server-side paging of order and invoice lists; generic sorting by computed columns.
  * Deleted entries can be restored; links of moved pages lead to the new pages.
- JIRA issue links in structure element, structure tree, order and time sheet lists and forms.
- Light/dark theme toggle, logos adapted to dark mode.
- Overlapping time sheets allowed for shared cost elements.
- Recently used menu entries, shared by all frontends; quick access search for the menu.
- Invoice statistics with a year-earlier comparison.

++++
{% include tag.html tag="fixed" %}
++++
- Order book and invoices no longer freeze when two caches refresh at once (cross-lock deadlock); invoice cache no longer refreshes inside a write transaction.
- Many N+1 query floods (order list, invoice lists, data transfer audit job, vacation events, employees, books, groups).
- Large ID lists are batched to stay under the database's bind parameter limit.
- Project managers can save orders in the new frontend again.
- Customer name search finds words inside the name.
- Invoiced amounts survive a restart.

++++
{% include tag.html tag="security" %}
++++
- Redirect URLs can no longer smuggle in a foreign host.
- Saving orders and cost centres asks for a second factor again.

++++
{% include tag.html tag="docker" %}
++++
- Docker container is buildable and startable again; step by step guide for a test instance.
====

[discrete#release-8-2-snapshot-20260816.changelog-release]
=== ProjectForge 8.2 snapshot (2026-08-16)

[.changelog-source]
__2026-08-16, snapshot build https://github.com/micromata/projectforge/commit/e8819bffc[develop@e8819bffc], https://github.com/micromata/projectforge/compare/0095d878f..e8819bffc[changes since 0095d878f]__ +++{% include release-pills.html %}+++

- First snapshot with **projectforge-next** under `+/next+`
- New login with 2FA under `+/next/login+`
- Order book, books and Kost1 in the new frontend
- Security: CSRF protection, stay-logged-in tokens per device

.Overview
[%collapsible]
====
- **projectforge-next:** the new frontend runs side by side with the existing one under `+/next+`; every migrated page links back to its classic counterpart.
- **Login:** login, two-factor authentication and password reset; `+/next/login+` is the only login of the application.
- **Tables:** column reordering and pinning, persisted layouts, filter panel, filter pills and saved filter favorites.
- **Migrated pages:** books, Kost1 and the order book with positions, payment schedule, statistics and exports; attachments and change history as a tab.
- **Forecast and orders:** configurable distribution of unused budget, run-rate extrapolation, probability of occurrence shown.
- **Further additions:** reindexing as a cancellable job, clone button for Merlin templates, response compression.
- **Fixes:** regressions after the TanStack migration, invoiced order sums no longer 0, identity provider ID kept on user edit, history value search, order notification mails.
- **Security:** stay logged in with one token per device, filter chain review, CSRF protection and full field validation for REST writes.
====

.All changes
[%collapsible]
====
First snapshot with **projectforge-next**, the new frontend that runs side by side with the existing one under `+/next+`.

++++
{% include tag.html tag="added" %}
++++
- **projectforge-next**
  * Login, two-factor authentication and password reset; `+/next/login+` is the only login of the application.
  * Tables with column reordering, pinning, persisted layouts, filter panel, removable filter pills and saved filter favorites.
  * Pages declared from the backend's entity metadata; field rules generated from the entities instead of being repeated.
  * Books, Kost1 and the order book (list, edit page with positions and payment schedule, statistics, Excel and forecast exports).
  * Attachments with upload progress, multi selection, ZIP download; change history as its own tab.
  * Every migrated page keeps a link back to its classic counterpart.
- Reindexing as a cancellable job with progress indicator.
- Clone button for Merlin templates.

++++
{% include tag.html tag="improved" %}
++++
- Forecast: configurable distribution of unused budget, run-rate extrapolation for call-off and fixed-rate orders.
- Order: probability of occurrence shown; positions marked red only when really due for invoicing.
- Numeric columns right-aligned, time sheet periods sorted chronologically.
- Response compression enabled.

++++
{% include tag.html tag="fixed" %}
++++
- File transfer, row selection and structure tree regressions after the TanStack migration.
- Identity provider ID no longer cleared on user edit.
- LDAP move/rename of legacy cn-based entries.
- Invoiced sums of orders no longer 0 after concurrent cache refreshes.
- Login redirect no longer overwrites the return URL.
- Search for a value in the change history works again.
- Order notification mails no longer break saving the order.

++++
{% include tag.html tag="security" %}
++++
- Stay logged in: one token per device, throttling, cookie only after 2FA, purge job.
- Security review of the filter chain: trusted proxies, client IP detection, throttling of public key endpoints, unbiased tokens.
- CSRF protection for the REST calls of the new frontend; REST writes validate all fields including string lengths.

++++
{% include tag.html tag="docker" %}
++++
- The Spring profile is no longer lost via the generated environment.sh.
====

- **Fixes:** attachments of outgoing invoices, corrupt downloads of large files, forecast month count, LDAP sync with externally moved entries, Merlin PDF fonts, CardDAV PUT requests on newer macOS.

====

.All changes
[%collapsible]
====
The table framework moved from AG Grid to TanStack React Table.

++++
{% include tag.html tag="improved" %}
++++

- Forecast export: comparison with the year before last.
- Structure elements: title length increased from 40 to 100 characters.

++++
{% include tag.html tag="fixed" %}
++++
- Outgoing invoices: attachments on the edit page and attachment column in the list; attachment counter updated after PDF upload/deletion.
- Corrupt downloads of large files.
- Forecast: number of months for invoicing in the following month.
- LDAP sync no longer blocks on entries moved externally.
- Merlin PDF conversion handles Identity-H encoding for unregistered fonts.
- CardDAV: PUT requests bypassed the filter on newer macOS versions.

++++
{% include tag.html tag="admin" %}
++++
- Action for resetting the identity provider password synchronization of all users.

++++
{% include tag.html tag="security" %}
++++
- High-severity npm vulnerabilities in projectforge-webapp fixed.
====
